title: mixedcheck compiled registry
description: The compiled registry, spec/compiled/registry.json, which spec/tools/compile_registry.py writes from the YAML sources in spec/registry/ and which both packages read. docs/spec/registry.md is normative together with this schema. The file holds exactly its canonical bytes (E4018), and its SHA-256 is the registry hash (conventions.md, Hashes). The entries are in ascending order of identifier (E4017), every check that a link names exists (E4004) and the links form no cycle (E4005). registry_version is the version member that readers check first (E1441).

registry_version.description: The registry version, equal to 'registry' in spec/versions.json.

privacy.title: privacy parameters
privacy.description: The parameters of the privacy filter that shareable output passes through (02-decisions.md, Q5). A displayed cell, bin or band holds at least min_count distinct members of the disclosure unit. A person count below min_count is shown as '<' followed by min_count. The 'contributors' largest contributors supply less than 'share' of a bin's rows. A quantile p is shown only if n * min(p, 1 - p) >= min_count, and two quantiles p and q of the same n only if n * |p - q| >= min_count. Suppressed tables have every cell rounded to a multiple of rounding_base. Zeros in cross-tabulations of person attributes are treated as disclosive when zeros_disclosive is true.
